scope: Method-consistency audit and CPU-only synthetic numerical references, before real replay or pilot evaluation
reference_provenance_limit: Reference is the current local OpenEQA production script/config source with hashes below. Imported processed_v1 packages do not carry a complete per-scene production commit/checkpoint lock; no claim is made that inspecting these files proves every historical binary/checkpoint invocation.

checks.openeqa_reference: (1+phys_bias)*point_overlap+(1-phys_bias)*CLIP_cosine; phys_bias=0, sim_threshold=1.2; match equality accepted
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Explicit phys_bias field; exact norm-divided cosine rather than treating a near-unit dot as cosine. Independent scalar references exercise 0,+.25,-.5.

checks.openeqa_reference: Count observed/new points whose nearest existing point has Euclidean distance strictly below voxel_size=.025m, divide by number of observed/new points
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: KD-tree double precision replaces FAISS float32 squared-distance search. Direction and strict radius independently checked against brute-force Euclidean distances.

checks.openeqa_reference: Both image and text: normalize(n1*f1+n2*f2); update observation count by n1+n2
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Sequential normalized count weighting is preserved; it is not claimed to equal the arithmetic mean of all raw feature vectors after many updates.

checks.openeqa_reference: confidence>=.25; mask pixel count>=max(25,10); exclude wall/floor/ceiling; raw detector bbox area<=.5*image area; valid depth pixels>=16
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Reusable defaults restored. Raw masks and float detector boxes persisted unchanged; filtered/subtracted effective masks are separate artifacts and actual interaction inputs.

checks.openeqa_reference: OpenEQA max_bbox_area_ratio=.5
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: configs/alfred/scene.toml explicitly sets 1.0 before evaluation to retain near-camera containers. This is a declared ALFRED parameter change, not a required property of incremental mapping.

checks.openeqa_reference: Subtract child mask where intersection/parent_box_area<.7 AND intersection/child_box_area>.8, in original index order
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Raw detector boxes, raw masks, image/text features remain unchanged. Mapping effective masks and rejection reasons are separately preserved; executor must use current_detection_masks.

checks.openeqa_reference: Open3D cloud minimum minus half a voxel; voxel=.025m; average points/colors
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Replaces the initial world-zero lattice. Two translated synthetic cases match native Open3D0.19.0 CPU voxel_down_sample to 1e-12, ignoring output order. Navigation/region grids independently retain a fixed world origin.

checks.openeqa_reference: eps=.1m,min_points10; retain largest cluster, preserve input if no cluster or largest cluster<5
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Deterministic CPU implementation handles border reassignment. Tiny-cluster guard restored; native pipeline jitter is separately excluded.

checks.openeqa_reference: Original map has no max_points cap
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: All valid mask pixels now reach voxel reduction; removed preprojection40000 cap. Voxel and DBSCAN finish before the declared4096-point final cap. Cap can alter future overlap/density versus uncapped offline mapping and is not a bitwise equivalence claim.

checks.openeqa_reference: Denoise/merge interval20; overlap>.7,image_cosine>.8,text_cosine>.8; sort pair overlap descending
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Strict threshold boundaries restored. Candidate pairs ranked by descending maximum directed overlap; original sorts directed entries. Oldest stable ID survives; resolved aliases prevent counting a retired object twice. Tie ordering differs deterministically.

checks.openeqa_reference: Reference gets hull-PCA Open3D oriented boxes and gates using oriented 3D IoU>=1e-6; volume<1e-6 rejected
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Current uses deterministic hull-PCA boxes and separating-axis intersection before the same nearest-point kernel. This restores orientation-based pruning but does not compute exact intersection volume/IoU cutoff. Degenerate/planar boxes are retained; numerically failed convex hull uses PCA of all points with a documented path. SceneObject export still uses AABB min/max coordinates.

checks.openeqa_reference: Original backprojection adds Gaussian position noise sigma=.004m and generates random instance colors
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: No geometric jitter is added. Float64 SciPy geometry and deterministic ordering replace mixed Open3D/FAISS numerical choices. This can affect clustering and bbox gates; it is not attributed to online necessity.

checks.openeqa_reference: Reference indexes a mutable list; filter/merge compacts indices
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Monotonic object IDs and alias events preserve references used by actions and historical retrieval; IDs never reused.

checks.openeqa_reference: Reference fuses all matched observations into a static cloud
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Action-confirmed pickup/put/open/close invalidate affected current geometry and observation recency; moved geometry is replaced on reacquisition. Held/sliced identities use explicit state, and raw history remains available as stale evidence. No simulator IDs or hidden object geometry are used.

checks.openeqa_reference: Offline final filter normally requires >=3 detections
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Keep immediately queryable provisional identities; confirm after three distinct matched frames. Do not delete a newly encountered action target because future evidence has not arrived.

checks.openeqa_reference: Reference assigns each detection row independently to its highest-scoring existing object, permitting many-to-one in one frame
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: New duplicate-mask suppression then one-to-one greedy score matching prevents duplicate support inflation and conflation of current interaction masks. This changes association semantics and is not merely stable-ID bookkeeping.

checks.openeqa_reference: Reference periodic merge does not permanently prohibit merging objects once coobserved
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: New memory refuses consolidation if two IDs share any observed frame. Protects distinct same-class interaction targets but can retain an oversegmentation introduced in one frame; requires empirical validation.

checks.openeqa_reference: Reference most_common_class uses unweighted class-id frequency
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: category_evidence is an integer count of distinct-frame category observations; confidence is not a vote weight and remains stored on ObjectView for view quality. Merged identities add per-category counts. Highest vote count wins; equal counts choose the lexically smallest category, a deterministic tie rule rather than depending on historical class-ID ordering. Regression confirms two confidence0.3 Mug observations beat one confidence0.95 Cup observation.

checks.openeqa_reference: Reference skips periodic maintenance after empty foreground frames and unconditionally denoises/filters/merges at offline sequence end
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Online maintenance runs every20 observations, including frames without new detections; no unconditional terminal pruning/final pack pass is implied. Action decisions use current provisional state, not a precomputed final sequence.

checks.openeqa_reference: At phys_bias0 and threshold1.2, overlap0 cannot match because cosine<=1
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Current explicitly requires positive point overlap. Under other exposed phys_bias/threshold values it is stricter than reference sim_sum; declared v9 uses the matched default configuration.

checks.openeqa_reference: OpenEQA uses RAM per-frame/accumulated category tags
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: ALFRED uses the fixed complete canonical vocabulary, including state-derived categories, without current-scene GT class metadata or instruction-based pruning.

checks.openeqa_reference: Original detector float bbox plus20px padding, unmasked RGB background, direct category text without photo template; SAM multimask=True and quality argmax
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: Perception agent corrected the earlier tight-mask gray-background crop and text prefix. Bounding boxes persist through geometry; CLIP extraction happens before mask subtraction. Module owned by parent/perception agent and separately gated.

checks.openeqa_reference: Legacy phrases2classes extracts first word, substring-matches first category, and may fall back to class0
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: New fixed-vocabulary token-span scoring chooses the highest-scoring valid category span above the text threshold, instead of legacy first-word substring matching or a silent unknown-phrase class0 fallback. Exact score ties follow fixed vocabulary order; semantic ambiguity is not claimed to be eliminated. Global cross-caption NMS remains class-agnostic at IoU .5.

checks.openeqa_reference: Offline OpenEQA uses recorded RGB-D/poses and a final prepared object/view index
checks.current_implementation_and_reason: ALFRED uses predicted metric depth and action odometry, plus separate free/occupied/unknown and observation coverage maps, collisions and exploration. Depth/pose noise means static mathematical agreement cannot establish task performance.

all_alfred_suite.failure_scope: Two executor test fixture paths outside mapping implementation; parent subsequently corrected paths and reported20/20 executor tests passed. Final fullsrc gate is parent-owned.

mapping_geometry_reference_tests_in_suit.scope: 59 CPU mapping/geometry/reference regressions passed after the final unweighted-category restore; includes image/text fusion, masks, aliases, voxel/DBSCAN and true-cosine boundaries.

native_cpu_voxel_reference.scope: CPU-only synthetic voxel/color numerical reference; no original pickle/data/model/GPU/replay

remaining_validation: Parent full repository gates after all source changes settle.
Only after a clean authorized commit: frozen train-depth capture, model comparison, then frozen pilot15.
A future read-only real-cache parity replay must first establish cache provenance and a safe data representation; synthetic references do not replace it.
final_source_freeze: No further mapping changes planned after this audit refresh; parent owns final repository gates and commit.
